Death's Head of Bhaal Blythe is a human Death's Head of Bhaal found in the Undercity outside the Guildhall in Act Three.
“
Your bloody trail returns you to us. Will you partake now?
„
— Blythe

Involvement

Blythe can be found alongside  Dogaletto,  Kryss, and  Phylle attacking refugees. If the player character has made a deal with  Orin, they are not immediately hostile and the party can decide to join in, side with the refugees, or ignore them.

Damage: 7~10
1d4 + 6⁠Piercing
Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon.

 Stunning Gaze ()

Targets one creature it can see within 18 m (60 ft). The target must succeed a  Wisdom Saving Throw or be  Stunned until the end of its next turn.

Tactician difficulty: This action does not require concentration.
